wholePhysicalScope: Named mapped temple polygon, Ministry and Archaeological Survey dimensions, UNESCO nomination dossier, and the original public-domain exterior photographs.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain all four porches, stepped terraces and the central golden tower.
limitations: Exact stucco carving, relief plaques, window tracery and some individual tower profiles are approximate.
Model scope covers the temple’s exterior and four connected entry halls. Interior shrines and detached enclosure structures remain outside the structure model.
